title: emon gold file, version 1.0 (SPEC 14.3; DEVLOG P2.8, D041, D063)
description: Ground truth for one corpus document: a PARTIAL emon Model (`model`) plus a declaration of what is annotated (`annotated`). A metric reads `annotated` first and skips what the gold does not claim (DocLayNet-derived gold has no heading levels; synthetic gold has no geometry). Inside what is annotated the gold is exact: a node of an annotated kind that is absent from `model` is a claim that none exists. `model.body` is an ordinary emon-1 document (ids in document order; no `at`, `src`, `conf` or `flags`, which are never annotated by synthetic gold). Conventions that are decisions, not facts, are in DEVLOG D063.

provenance.description: Where the document came from. Synthetic gold: the HTML it was authored as, the PDF a producer printed from it (and the producer), and variants that share this gold (a tagged print, a degraded scan).

structure.description: Node kinds whose presence AND absence is annotated.

attributes.description: Per kind, the fields that are annotated. An annotated field that is absent is absent in the truth.

layout.description: `facts.frags` is exhaustive: every leaf block of the body has its fragments listed (D114). Absent means false.

text.description: Leaf-block `text` is annotated (reading order, NFC, whitespace normalized, refs contribute none, linebreaks \n).

inlines.description: `inlines` are annotated (style spans, links, refs, linebreaks).

dropped.description: Ledger reasons whose entries are exhaustive (an absent entry of these reasons is a claim). Entries carry no `at`.

model.description: A partial emon Model (emon-1.json, SPEC 4.2). Same keys, same canonical meaning; `furniture` and `dropped` items are loosened (below) because their geometry is unknown.

facts.description: What printing the document showed, found by tools/synth/build.clj from `pdftotext -bbox-layout` and committed in MANIFEST.json (D114). Node ids are body ids. `frags`: per leaf block, its fragments [page, band, col] in reading order (a block broken by a column or a page has several). `lines`: the printed line count of every block that has `align` or an initial. `hyphens`: every word the printer hyphenated at a line or column end: `printed` is the word as printed (with its hyphen), `word` the HTML's word.

tl-untrusted.description: The document's text layer is wrong or older than the pixels ON PURPOSE (a rewritten ToUnicode, a worse hidden OCR layer, D209): the scorer's `tl-override` skips it, because overriding that text layer is the right behaviour.

furniture.description: A running header/footer kept by policy (SPEC 10.2). `template` is the printed text; `{n}` stands for the page number where the text varies by page. `pages` are the pages it printed on.

dropped.description: A ledger entry without geometry. `text` is the text exactly as it printed on that page.
